query_analysis.expanded_query: Provide detailed guidelines and best practices for designing pressure relief systems specifically for a flash separator operating with high-pressure carbon dioxide, considering safety standards and regulatory compliance.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Safety requirements and standards are integrated with the separator's operation data to design an effective relief system
